title: Superhost Cleaning Allowance on Roamhaven Listings Cleaning Fees
content:
# Superhost Cleaning Allowance

*Host recognition clause, Roamhaven Listings, read against the host's Host Accounts record.*

**Clause.** On top of the standard cleaning-fee ceiling, a listing may carry a Superhost cleaning allowance, worked out on the day of the cleaning-fee reset from the Host Accounts record of the host account the listing belongs to:

- when the host account's tier is **Superhost** and its Superhost date — the date Superhost was awarded in the account's current run — lies **24 or more whole months** before the day of the reset, the Superhost cleaning allowance is **$20.00**;
- when the tier is **Superhost** and that date lies **fewer** whole months back, it is **$10.00**;
- for **any other tier**, there is no Superhost cleaning allowance.

The allowance is added to the listing's cleaning-fee ceiling.

## The clause as a table

| Host account tier | Whole months from the Superhost date to the day of the reset | Superhost cleaning allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Superhost | 24 or more | $20.00 |
| Superhost | fewer than 24 | $10.00 |
| Starter Host, Standard Host, Professional Host, Professional Host Plus or Enterprise Partner | — | none |

## Cases (hypothetical accounts)

- A Superhost account awarded on 2024-06-15, reset on 2026-06-15: 24 whole months, $20.00.
- The same account, reset on 2026-06-14: 23 whole months, $10.00.
- A Professional Host Plus account that was a Superhost in an earlier year: its tier is not Superhost, so there is no Superhost cleaning allowance.
